items.title: Crypto is going through a massive dot-com style shakeout as over 100 projects fold in 2026
items.snippet: An industry-wide reckoning is weeding out unsustainable startups, leaving behind only the protocols with real cash flow and actual users.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
items.snippet: The enforcing fork remains stuck at Bitcoin’s full mining difficulty as mandatory signaling proceeds with little hashpower support.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Brazil targets crypto fraud with up to 24-hour transfer hold
items.snippet: The rules, effective Jan. 1, 2027, cover transactions above $10,000 sent to overseas providers or self-custody wallets, along with other transfers flagged for review.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: BTCPay restricts remote Lightning access after attackers steal funds
items.snippet: Foundation and Citadel21 reported drained Lightning nodes, but the total amount stolen and number of affected operators remain unknown.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Controversial Bitcoin fork BIP-110 mines two blocks, then stops
items.snippet: The breakaway chain inherited bitcoin’s mining difficulty with only a tiny share of hashpower, leaving blocks hours apart while both chains still accept the same transactions.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
